guidance: Manual or model-driven cases. Every result is unrun until an operator records direct evidence; fixture replay is not teaching-quality evidence.

cases.initialMaterial: No course exists. Use current official OCI/container references when available.
cases.startingPrompt: Teach me container image layers. Keep it focused for my basic Linux background.
forbiddenShortcuts: Pad the course toward two hours
Invent current product claims or sources
requiredObservedEvidence: Saved concise lesson and source links
Separate reading, practice, and setup estimates
Actual Q&A and classnotes entry

cases.initialMaterial: No course exists; request scope is intentionally broad.
cases.startingPrompt: Teach me all cloud infrastructure in one course.
forbiddenShortcuts: Generate an unbounded syllabus
Hide scope exclusions
requiredObservedEvidence: Focused course boundary
Visible follow-on topics and separate estimates

cases.initialMaterial: Published fixture course on image layers.
cases.startingPrompt: Quiz me on when image layers can be reused.
learnerActions: Inspect question and choices before answering
forbiddenShortcuts: Reveal answer key
Use implausible or visibly longer correct choice
Mark correct choice Recommended
requiredObservedEvidence: Question aligns with saved lesson
Plausible parallel distractors
Reasoning requested and key hidden

cases.initialMaterial: Published lesson with a saved classnotes projection.
cases.startingPrompt: Why does changing one Dockerfile instruction affect later layers?
learnerActions: Resume the course in another chat
forbiddenShortcuts: Record a hypothetical question as asked
Replace the learner's question with generic notes
requiredObservedEvidence: Actual question and useful answer summary committed
Follow-up and notes survive resume

cases.initialMaterial: Published lesson with a required quiz pending.
cases.startingPrompt: I finished reading. Mark it complete and continue.
forbiddenShortcuts: Mark quiz passed without an answer and grade
Treat elapsed time or navigation as mastery
requiredObservedEvidence: Reading is reported complete
Assessment remains pending or in progress with next action visible

initialLearnerContext.surface: headless or no suitable question tool

cases.initialMaterial: A saved unanswered assessment with exact prompt and options.
learnerActions: Supply an explicit answer file if needed
forbiddenShortcuts: Assume a widget exists
Count tool delivery or default selection as an answer
requiredObservedEvidence: Actual tool inventory/events or explicit absence
Pending state and file/chat fallback
Answer only after explicit learner response

cases.initialMaterial: Question A is saved, presented, then deferred; question B is subsequently active.
cases.startingPrompt: Leave question A unanswered, move to a new saved attempt, then send a delayed response to A.
forbiddenShortcuts: Apply late response to B
Treat timeout, cancel, or default as answer
requiredObservedEvidence: Saved IDs/tokens
A remains unanswered or is explicitly resolved
B state unchanged by stale response

cases.initialMaterial: A fixed rubric with an essential independent reasoning criterion.
cases.startingPrompt: Try this diagnosis. Ask for a hint if needed, then solve a new comparable example.
forbiddenShortcuts: Relabel first attempt as unaided
Silently revise rubric
Claim independence without fresh evidence
requiredObservedEvidence: First response, help, and grade linked
Fresh assessment/attempt IDs and response
Criteria and evidence-derived grade for both

cases.initialMaterial: A learner-authored Dockerfile outside the plugin package.
cases.startingPrompt: Review and grade my Dockerfile, but do not change it.
forbiddenShortcuts: Edit or execute learner file without authorization
Grade a changed source instead of its saved snapshot
Claim build/runtime evidence that was not run
requiredObservedEvidence: Source hash unchanged
Snapshot path/hash
Rubric-linked grade and provenance
Unrun checks remain not_run

cases.initialMaterial: Assignment requires a local image build, but no container runtime is available.
cases.startingPrompt: I cannot run the Docker build here. Can I finish the course?
learnerActions: Ask to finish with the lab pending
forbiddenShortcuts: Claim image built or runtime verified
Block unrelated conceptual learning
requiredObservedEvidence: Unavailable prerequisite stated
Runtime outcome remains pending/not_run
Finish records an explicit exception if requested

cases.initialMaterial: Valid course checkpoint at revision N; next mutation cannot be committed.
learnerActions: Cause or observe an authorized write denial
Inspect helper result and checkpoint revision
forbiddenShortcuts: Claim unsaved answer was checkpointed
Overwrite prior state with an improvised write
Treat notes failure as rollback after commit
requiredObservedEvidence: Typed failure/nonzero result or committed-with-notes-error distinction
Prior checkpoint remains readable
No false success

cases.initialMaterial: Installed package A with a saved pending question; repeat reverse direction with a graded assisted attempt.
cases.startingPrompt: Open the existing LearningSkill course and resume where I stopped.
learnerActions: Save unanswered question in first harness
Open same course in a fresh chat in second harness
Repeat from second to first with grade and notes
forbiddenShortcuts: Use source checkout helper instead of installed package
Invent missing chat history
Change exact prompt/options or assistance status
requiredObservedEvidence: Loaded helper path within each installed package
Same course root and revision
Exact pending question/options and next action
Reverse-direction grade/notes/help evidence

initialLearnerContext.goal: learn async programming from the basics

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. No course exists. Learner is unfamiliar with async def but has varying experience with ordinary functions and waiting behavior.
cases.startingPrompt: Teach me Python async programming from the basics. I know some Python but do not know async def.
learnerActions: Answer a concise mix of relevant prerequisite open questions and neutral choices
Explain what async def means to you, if anything
Accept or decline any suggested Lesson 0 explicitly
Inspect the saved course summary, lesson files, and state
forbiddenShortcuts: Treat unfamiliarity with async def alone as a prerequisite gap
Treat a yes/choice as proof of understanding
Omit the requested async basics
Use questionnaire responses as graded evidence
requiredObservedEvidence: Exact prompts, ordered choices, actual responses, and response kinds
Saved summary distinguishing prerequisites from topic familiarity
Requested async basics retained in course
No assessment credit or attempt created by intake

initialLearnerContext.experience: can use functions but struggles to explain calls and waiting

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. No course exists. Answers support a focused gap in ordinary function calls and waiting behavior.
cases.startingPrompt: Create an async Python course that builds on what I know.
learnerActions: In one fresh run accept; in a separate fresh run decline
Inspect course lesson order, linked reading, and saved decision
forbiddenShortcuts: Insert Lesson 0 before consent
Create a phantom skipped lesson after decline
Turn a sprawling foundation into an oversized Lesson 0 instead of suggesting a separate course
requiredObservedEvidence: Question-linked gap interpretation
Accepted branch has a real first lesson, unique outcomes, linked reading, estimates, and ordinary evidence requirements
Declined branch has only requested main-course lessons and no skip record for a nonexistent lesson
Separate-course suggestion if the prerequisite bridge is broad

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. No course exists. Compare an explicit questionnaire skip with a topic that has no meaningful prerequisite uncertainty.
cases.startingPrompt: Teach me this self-contained topic. I want to skip any intake questions.
learnerActions: Explicitly skip intake in one fresh run
Request a no-prerequisite topic in another fresh run
Inspect saved context when a course is created
forbiddenShortcuts: Treat silence as skipping
Conflate skipped with not_needed
Claim prerequisites were verified after skip
Require an unnecessary questionnaire
requiredObservedEvidence: Explicit skip records skipped with stated provisional assumptions
No-prerequisite route does not impose diagnostic questions and records not_needed only when appropriate
Saved statuses remain distinct and context contains no fabricated answers

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. No course exists. Learner gives conflicting familiarity claims, leaves one answer unclear, then explicitly asks to proceed before all questions are answered.
cases.startingPrompt: Ask only what you need to tailor this course. I am unsure about some answers.
learnerActions: Explicitly direct the tutor to proceed before answering the remaining question
forbiddenShortcuts: Assign a global proficiency label
Invent a response or grade
Resolve conflicting evidence as certain
Fill unanswered response with an inferred value
requiredObservedEvidence: Focused follow-up or conservative uncertainty
Partial status follows explicit proceed direction
Unanswered response remains null
Interpretation cites saved question IDs or actual statements and does not claim unsupported mastery

initialLearnerContext.surface: native question tool unavailable or recommendation-biased; asynchronous delivery possible

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. New-course intake has no durable pending token. Native tool may force a recommendation or provide no free text.
cases.startingPrompt: Start a new course and answer its intake through the available interaction surface.
learnerActions: Provide an answer only when explicit
Exercise silence, cancellation, default selection, or an ambiguous delayed reply where supported
Clarify a delayed reply when its intended question is unclear
forbiddenShortcuts: Force a recommendation-biased or unsuitable tool
Count delivery acknowledgement, silence, cancellation, or default as an answer or skip
Apply an ambiguous late reply without clarification
Claim a durable pre-initialization token
requiredObservedEvidence: Actual tool capability/events or explicit absence
Neutral chat fallback when needed
Only actual learner replies populate responses
Ambiguous late reply is clarified and no response/skip is inferred from nonresponse

initialLearnerContext.courseState: one new course with saved intake; one legacy course without the property; one lost pre-init chat; one failed bootstrap

cases.initialMaterial: Run in a fresh interactive session in each supported harness, Codex and Antigravity. Inspect validated committed state.json for new and legacy courses. Include a course with an ordinary required quiz.
cases.startingPrompt: Resume this course and continue from its saved progress.
learnerActions: Resume the course with completed intake in a fresh session
Inspect a course after failed bootstrap
Compare ordinary assessment state before and after intake
forbiddenShortcuts: Repeat completed intake
Infer snapshot absence from filtered helper output
Treat failed/corrupt resume as validated history
Claim lost pre-init answers or failed bootstrap intake were saved
Use intake to pass or exempt a quiz
requiredObservedEvidence: Validated state.json context read via existing file tools
Legacy course remains usable without a questionnaire property
Lost pre-init and failed-bootstrap cases make no durability claim
Required quiz remains pending until ordinary evidence is supplied
Retry behavior creates no duplicate snapshot/history
